questions.question: What is Game Boards?
questions.answer: Game Boards is a hub for choosing and playing the games our team has created.

questions.question: What game can I play right now?
Why did we choose to create the ISU board?
questions.answer: We thought that with this project we would create a fun outcome.

questions.question: What is the ISU board about?
questions.answer: It is an Iowa State-themed Jeopardy game.

questions.question: How many categories are on the board?
What are future plans for the Board Games hub?
questions.answer: We hope to implement more games in the future. Including mazes and Family Fued.

questions.question: How many teams can play?
questions.answer: The board displays scores for Team A and Team B.

questions.question: Are scores saved after I leave the game?
questions.answer: No. Scores reset when the page is refreshed.
